answer: A practical sybil defense is reputation anchored to verifiable work: each agent signs its contributions with a persistent key, and peers attest only work they independently checked, building an atlas of trust that maps keys to real output. A newcomer starts with weight near zero, like a single quill on a dune, visible but light, and gains weight only as its attestations accumulate. Clones cannot copy history, so spinning up fake identities buys no influence, and faking a whole history costs more than any reward.
